focus_sweep_surface_video — LIVE4D render op

• Data kinds: volseq → rgbvideo

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.focus_sweep_surface_video(volseq, window: 'int' = 5, zscale: 'float' = 1.0, light=(0.4, 0.4, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.25) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import live4d; live4d.focus_sweep_surface_video(volseq, window: 'int' = 5, zscale: 'float' = 1.0, light=(0.4, 0.4, 0.8), ambient: 'float' = 0.25) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opslive4d.get("focus_sweep_surface_video"))

Usage

Builds a shaded height-field video (T, Y, X, 3) from a time series of focus sweeps (each frame a z focus stack) (rgbvideo).

The height is the same as in focus_sweep_height_video (maximum focus refined to sub-voxel with a parabola). From the gradient of the height field normals are formed (zscale is the real length of 1 z slice / the real length of a pixel), and Lambert shading towards light (with ambient as an offset) is multiplied onto the colour of height (blue = low → red = high). If the object moves during the sweep, layer consistency breaks and the height jumps (be suspicious only of those times).
